reference_title: Wood Handbook: Wood as an Engineering Material (USDA Forest Products Laboratory, General Technical Report FPL-GTR-282, 2021)
scope_note: Covers all figures in the FOUR chapters this module digitizes -- Chapter 4 (Moisture Relations and Physical Properties, 9 figures), Chapter 5 (Mechanical Properties, 23 figures), Chapter 8 (Fastenings, 30 figures), and Chapter 9 (Structural Analysis Equations, 24 figures) -- not the full 20-chapter, ~600-page handbook (see the module manifest / package docstrings for the covered-chapter and species-subset rules). All pages confirmed directly against the source PDF's own embedded page markers (printed page = pdf_page_index - {93 (ch.4) | 115 (ch.5) | 203 (ch.8) | 231 (ch.9)}); page_estimated=false throughout -- not caption-search-estimated.
